```bash
claude plugin eval ./my-plugin --trust-plugin --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --judge-model claude-opus-5-5 --json results.json --threshold 0.8 --no-publish
```

Gotchas: pin both models by full ID so a model rollout isn't read as a regression; `--trust-plugin` is required because a non-TTY job is refused otherwise; read results.json as well as the exit code, since exit 1 has several causes and exit 2 means partial.

Run `claude plugin eval . --trust-plugin --model <full model ID> --judge-model <full model ID> --json out.json`. Never pin with an alias like `sonnet`. Parse out.json with jq rather than trusting the exit code alone.
